item.summary: fix(gateway): report device worker capacity distinctly from disconnection (#124340) * fix(gateway): report device worker capacity distinctly from disconnection This separates paired, disconnected, and connected-but-saturated device worker failures so capacity exhaustion no longer looks like disconnection. Saturated hosts now tell operators to retry after a running turn completes, and table-driven coverage asserts all three messages. AI-assisted. * test(gateway): expect unpaired reason in startup availability probe
